The food looks like a folded omelet on a plate that is roughly 26 cm across. In the image the plate spans about 400 px, so about 15 px per cm.

The omelet is about 100 px wide and 240 px long, which is roughly 7 cm by 16 cm. Its thickness is probably 2.5 to 3 cm because it is folded.

Treating it as a rounded folded shape, the volume is about 7 × 16 × 2.5 × 0.6 ≈ 170 cm³. Omelet density is about 0.9 g/cm³, so it weighs roughly 150 g.

That is about a 3-egg omelet with some oil. At about 1.6 kcal/g, a 150 g omelet comes to roughly 240 kcal. Allowing for cooking oil, I'll estimate 250 kcal.
